key_challenge: Mosaic genome with mobile genetic elements, moderate AT-bias (~71% AT)

reference.notes: AM180355.1/NC_009089.1 is the canonical 630 reference. CP010905.2 is a SMRT-resequenced version that resolves some mobile elements — choose one and be consistent across the benchmark run.

simulation.command: dwgsim -1 150 -2 150 -C 100 -z {rng_seed} ../reference/reference.fasta reads && mv reads.bwa.read1.fastq.gz reads_1.fastq.gz && mv reads.bwa.read2.fastq.gz reads_2.fastq.gz

truth.simulated: dwgsim read name encodes true origin coordinates; evaluate with paftools.js mapeval

benchmark_notes: Mobile elements (Tn916-family, CTn elements) create repeat-driven ambiguity. Real short reads available under ENA sample ERS550098 (630Δerm). Mosaic genome structure means aligner behavior varies substantially by region.
